modifierOps: Increase the linked skill's damage, healing, or barrier magnitude by 15%.
executionNotes: Uses the normal Increased modifier bucket. Does not change status duration, radius, resource cost, or control strength unless those values are derived directly from the affected payload.
safetyNotes: Magnitude whitelist: direct damage, DoT DPS, healing and absorb capacity only; no cooldown, reservation, CC or Emanatism/Pedanticism utility coefficients.
fixture: accept Quick Slash; reject Emanatism (No scalable damage/healing/barrier payload). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.

modifierOps: Reduce the linked skill's declared spend cost or continuous upkeep by 15%.
executionNotes: Never reduces Mana Reservation percentages. Cost floors at 1 for non-zero integer costs. Reservation Auras use Conservation instead.
safetyNotes: Integer upfront cost = max(1, ceil(baseCost\*factor)); upkeep retains fractional precision with 0.25 s quanta. Zero remains zero.
fixture: accept Fireball; reject Managuard (Reservation is not an upfront spend). Maximum one copy per skill. Display the rejected gate in UI and revalidate it server-side.
